name: NAXDOM 250 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About NAXDOM 250 TABLET

NAXDOM 250 TABLET is a combination of Domperidone and Naproxen, which belong to the groups of medicines called antiemetics and NSAIDs (non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), respectively. It is used to manage the symptoms of migraine, menstrual migraine, and chronic daily headaches associated with nausea and vomiting.

A migraine is a recurring headache that often involves one side of the head and causes severe pain that is pulsating or throbbing and is accompanied by nausea, weakness, and sensitivity to sound and light.

NAXDOM 250 TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver, kidney, or heart problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding in the stomach or intestine, intestinal tears, or pituitary gland tumours. NAXDOM 250 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease, diabetes, high cholesterol, systemic lupus erythematosus, a blood clotting disorder, a history of gastrointestinal diseases, and a habit of drinking or smoking.

NAXDOM 250 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy, while breastfeeding, or in children less than 5 years old. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 60). The common side effect of taking NAXDOM 250 TABLET may include dry mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if your symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How NAXDOM 250 TABLET Works

NAXDOM 250 TABLET effectively manages migraine, which is commonly associated with nausea and vomiting, by blocking the centres in the brain and stomach that regulate nausea and vomiting. It also increases the contractions and movements in the stomach. NAXDOM 250 TABLET stops the pain pathways and reduces the release of substances (prostaglandins) that cause inflammation, thus decreasing pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use NAXDOM 250 TABLET

Take NAXDOM 250 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NAXDOM 250 TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

NAXDOM 250 TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NAXDOM 250 TABLET if you are allergic to Domperidone or Naproxen.

NAXDOM 250 TABLET not recommended in patients with severe heart disease such as heart failure, prolonged QT corrected interval. It should be used with caution in patients having a stroke or high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking NAXDOM 250 TABLET.

Others

NAXDOM 250 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have stomach or duodenal ulcers
Have bleeding in the stomach or intestines
Have a blockage or tear in the intestine
Have a tumour of the pituitary gland

Before taking NAXDOM 250 TABLET tell your doctor if you:

Have a history of disorders of the stomach or bowel (ulcerative colitis, Crohn’s disease)
Have diabetes
Have a habit of smoking
Have systemic lupus erythematosus or other connective tissue disorder
Have a blood clotting disorder

Use in paediatrics:

NAXDOM 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 5 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking NAXDOM 250 TABLET.

 Use in geriatrics:

NAXDOM 250 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 60 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following drugs before taking NAXDOM 250 TABLET:

Medicines used to manage heart problems, high blood pressure (Ex. amiodarone, dronedarone, quinidine, disopyramide, captopril, ramipril, losartan, candesartan, dofetilide, sotalol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used in the management of psychoses (Ex. haloperidol, pimozide, sertindole), depression (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram), mental illness (Ex. lithium), epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage gastrointestinal disorders (Ex. cisapride, dolasetron, prucalopride), antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide gel)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin, ciprofloxacin, telithromycin, moxifloxacin, pentamidine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. toremifene, methotrexate, vandetanib, vincamine)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much NAXDOM 250 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdoes of NAXDOM 250 TABLET can cause headaches, nausea, vomiting, sleepiness, confusion, heartburn, fainting, diarrhoea, disorientation, stomach or intestine bleeding, unconsciousness, drowsiness, dizziness, ringing or buzzing sensation in the ears, fits and excitation, unusual eye movements, unusual tongue movements, or abnormal posture (such as a twisted neck).

introduction:
Introduction About INDERAL 10MG TABLET

INDERAL 10MG TABLET is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure), angina (chest pain) and arrhythmia (irregular heart rhythm).

It can also be used to control abnormal increase in blood pressure and/or heart rate caused due to various underlying conditions such as anxiety, overactive thyroid gland, phaeochromocytoma (tumours of adrenal gland) or Hypertrophic Subaortic Stenosis (thickening of heart muscles).

It contains Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta blockers.

It can also be used to manage heart attacks and migraine headaches. It also controls shakiness of the body by blocking abnormal nerve signals between the brain and the muscles.

Before taking INDERAL 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other types of anginas (unstable or Prinzmetal angina) or arrhythmia (such as Wolf-Parkinson-White Syndrome), any breathing problems, or diabetes as a precaution.

INDERAL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe asthma, hypotension (low blood pressure) or shock. It is also not suitable for use in patients with heart block, history of heart attack or heart failure.

Do not take INDERAL 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking INDERAL 10MG TABLET are cold fingers and toes, slow heartbeat, tiredness, sleep disturbances and Raynaud’s syndrome (numbness and spasm in the fingers followed by warmth and pain). Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

Benefits of INDERAL 10MG TABLET in Hypertension:

This medication works by reducing the workload on the heart and relaxing blood vessels, resulting in improved blood flow and lower blood pressure levels.

Benefits of INDERAL 10MG TABLET in Angina pectoris:

It reduces chest pain episodes, improves exercise tolerance by minimizing the heart’s exertion, allowing individuals to perform daily activities with reduced discomfort. It also helps manage stress-induced angina by mitigating the physical effects of stress and anxiety on the heart, providing comprehensive protection for patients with this condition.

Benefits of INDERAL 10MG TABLET in arrhythmia:

It helps stabilize the heart by slowing electrical signals in the heart muscle. This action restores a regular rhythm, preventing episodes of rapid or irregular heartbeats.

Benefits of INDERAL 10MG TABLET in migraine:

It helps in preventing migraines by stabilizing blood vessels, modulating nerve activity and blood flow in the brain and reducing the triggers that cause migraine episodes. Many users report a noticeable decline in the frequency and severity of migraines over time.

Benefits of INDERAL 10MG TABLET in tremor and anxiety:

It works by blocking adrenaline’s effect on the body, which calms the overactive signals causing tremors. It is particularly effective in controlling physical symptoms of anxiety, such as a racing heart, sweating, and trembling. By calming the heart rate, it helps individuals feel more at ease in stressful situations. Blocks the body’s adrenaline response, it allows users to remain calm and confident during high-pressure scenarios.
mechanismOfAction:
How INDERAL 10MG TABLET Works

INDERAL 10MG TABLET is a beta-blocker. It works by blocking the actions of certain chemical messengers (such as adrenaline and noradrenaline) in our body that controls the function of the heart, brain and kidneys and lungs.

In the heart, stopping the actions of these chemical messengers reduces the heart rate and force of contraction. This helps to control abnormal heart rate in patients suffering from arrhythmia.

It can also reduce the risk of abnormal heart signs (such as racing heartbeat, nervousness and high blood pressure) associated with phaeochromocytoma or anxiety.

INDERAL 10MG TABLET can relax the blood vessels supplying the heart and the brain. This action improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart and makes the heart to pump blood more efficiently with less pressure. It also helps in managing and managing problems caused due to poor blood circulation such as chest pain (angina), heart attack or migraine.

Additionally, INDERAL 10MG TABLET reduces the production of thyroid hormones (triiodothyronine) in patients suffering from overactive thyroid gland. It also stops the transfer of abnormal nerve signals between the brain and the muscles which helps in reducing tremors.

warnings.details: INDERAL 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician, as it may harm the growing baby. Studies in animals have reported developmental abnormalities, including reduced fetal weight and delayed ossification, at high doses of propranolol. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking INDERAL 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you might be pregnant or planning to have a baby.

INDERAL 10MG TABLET may excrete in breast milk. Limited animal data exists specifically on the excretion of propranolol in milk, but beta-blockers as a class are known to pass into milk. Therefore, it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

INDERAL 10MG TABLET is unlikely to affect your ability for driving or handling any heavy tools or machines. However, if your experience any dizziness or drowsiness, do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines as a precaution.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking INDERAL 10MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
INDERAL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
INDERAL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take INDERAL 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to propranolol.

INDERAL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from asthma. It should be used with caution in patients with other respiratory problems (such as chronic bronchitis, emphysema, COPD or bronchospasm). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

INDERAL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with sinus bradycardia (slow heart beat due to problems in SA nodes), heart block, congestive heart failure or heart defects. It should be used with caution in patients with a previous history of heart failure or other heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

The safety and effectiveness of INDERAL 10MG TABLET have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, it should be used in children only if prescribed by the physician.

INDERAL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Animal studies indicate increased sensitivity to beta-blockers in older populations due to age-related changes in cardiovascular physiology and drug metabolism. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

INDERAL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have hypertensive emergency crisis (abnormal increase in blood pressure which is severe)
Have very low blood pressure
Have can increased acidity of the blood (metabolic acidosis)
Are on a strict fasting diet
Suffer from other forms of angina (Prinzmetal’s angina)

Before taking INDERAL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Suffer from unstable angina (chest pain that occurs in the absence of any stressful activity)
Are going for glaucoma screening test
Have muscle weakness (myasthenia gravis)
Are planning for any major surgery

Have any bleeding problems

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug - Drug interactions:

1. Calcium Channel Blockers (e.g., Verapamil, Diltiazem)

Both calcium channel blockers and beta-blockers like Inderal reduce heart rate and blood pressure. When taken together, they can cause excessive bradycardia (slow heart rate) and hypotension (low blood pressure).

2. Clonidine (Alpha-2 Agonist)

Clonidine can synergistically lower blood pressure. However, abrupt discontinuation of clonidine while on propranolol can cause a rebound hypertensive crisis.

3.Antiarrhythmic Drugs (e.g., Amiodarone, Sotalol)

Combining antiarrhythmic drugs can increase the risk of heart block and severe bradycardia, particularly in patients with pre-existing heart conditions.

4.Antidepressants (e.g., Fluoxetine, Paroxetine)

Some selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) may increase the plasma concentration of propranolol, potentially leading to an enhanced beta-blocking effect and increased risk of bradycardia.

5. Nonsteroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) (e.g., Ibuprofen, Naproxen)

NSAIDs may reduce the effectiveness of Inderal in controlling blood pressure by inhibiting the production of prostaglandins, which help regulate kidney function.

6.Insulin and Oral Hypoglycemics

Beta-blockers like propranolol can mask the symptoms of hypoglycemia (low blood sugar), making it harder to recognize low blood sugar levels, especially in diabetics.

7.Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (MAOIs) (e.g., Phenelzine, Tranylcypromine)

The combination of MAOIs and Inderal can lead to a hypertensive crisis due to excessive catecholamine release.

8.Ergot Alkaloids (e.g., Ergotamine)

Ergotamine, often used to treat migraines, can cause vasoconstriction, and when combined with propranolol, it may further increase the risk of severe hypertension or poor circulation.

More Information
Onset of Action: After taking a 40mg tablet of propranolol by mouth, the drug typically begins to take effect within 30 to 60 minutes. The maximum concentration of propranolol in the blood is usually reached around 1 to 2 hours after oral ingestion. At this point, the therapeutic effects are most pronounced, such as a reduction in heart rate, blood pressure, and anxiety symptoms.
Duration of Action: The effects of propranolol can last approximately 3 to 6 hours after a single dose. Propranolol also comes in extended-release formulations (such as Inderal LA), which can provide prolonged action, lasting up to 24 hours.

How NAXDOM 500 TABLET Works

NAXDOM 500 TABLET effectively manages migraine, which is commonly associated with nausea and vomiting, by blocking the centres in the brain and stomach that regulate nausea and vomiting. NAXDOM 500 TABLET stops the pain pathways and reduces the release of substances (prostaglandins) that cause inflammation, thus decreasing pain and inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About RIZACT 10MG TABLET

RIZACT 10MG TABLET contains Rizatriptan which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective serotonin 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor agonist. RIZACT 10MG TABLET is used in adults to manage headache phase of migraine attack.  

RIZACT 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Rizatriptan. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from moderate/mild/severe high blood pressure (which is not controlled by medication), stroke, peripheral vascular disease (condition marked by blockage of blood vessels), heart problems (such as heart attack, angina), and/or severe kidney/liver problems.

Before taking RIZACT 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, family history of heart disease, headache (associated with dizziness, difficulty in walking, lack of coordination), short lived symptoms (such as chest pain, tightness), and/or mild to moderate kidney/liver problems.

RIZACT 10MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary as it is not known whether the medicine can cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid nursing the child for next 24 hours after taking the medicine since it may cause unwanted effects in the nursing child.

RIZACT 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIZACT 10MG TABLET are tingling sensation of hands/feet, headache, sleeplessness, dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients

RIZACT 10MG TABLET works by constricting the blood vessels that surround the brain which results in reduced swelling in the blood vessels thus providing relief from headache that occurs in migraine attack in affected individuals.

A migraine is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain that can be moderate to severe. This generally involves one side of your head. The most common symptoms include nausea, weakness and sensitivity to light and sound.

FLUNARIN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for patients having depressive illness or a history of recurrent depression and Parkinson’s disease. FLUNARIN 10MG TABLET should not be taken by pregnant and breastfeeding women and children. FLUNARIN 10MG TABLET should be used with caution by the elderly. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side-effects of FLUNARIN 10MG TABLET are an increase in body weight and appetite, a blocked or runny nose, feeling low or depressed, problems with sleeping, nausea, constipation, stomach pain, muscle aches, painful breasts, menstrual problems, and feeling tired. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

name: Rizanet 5mg Oral Disintegrating Strips 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS contains Rizatriptan which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective serotonin 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor agonist. RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is used in adults to manage headache phase of migraine attack.  

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Rizatriptan. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from moderate/mild/severe high blood pressure (which is not controlled by medication), stroke, peripheral vascular disease (condition marked by blockage of blood vessels), heart problems (such as heart attack, angina), and/or severe kidney/liver problems.

Before taking RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, family history of heart disease, headache (associated with dizziness, difficulty in walking, lack of coordination), short lived symptoms (such as chest pain, tightness), and/or mild to moderate kidney/liver problems.

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary as it is not known whether the medicine can cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid nursing the child for next 24 hours after taking the medicine since it may cause unwanted effects in the nursing child.

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS are tingling sensation of hands/feet, headache, sleeplessness, dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS
Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
mechanismOfAction:
How RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS Works

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS works by constricting the blood vessels that surround the brain which results in reduced swelling in the blood vessels thus providing relief from headache that occurs in migraine attack in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS

Tablet

Take RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Oral Disintegrating Tablet / Mouth Dissolving Tablet:

Take RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS as advised by your physician. Place RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary as it is not known whether the medicine can cause harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid nursing the child for next 24 hours after taking the medicine. Consult your doctor before taking RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS.
Do not drive/operate machines if you feel dizzy/sleepy after taking RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS.

RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking RIZANET 5MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS.

A migraine is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain that can be moderate to severe. This generally involves one side of your head. The most common symptoms include nausea, weakness and sensitivity to light and sound.

FLUNER 10MG TABLET is not recommended for patients having depressive illness or a history of recurrent depression and Parkinson’s disease. FLUNER 10MG TABLET should not be taken by pregnant and breastfeeding women and children. FLUNER 10MG TABLET should be used with caution by the elderly. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side-effects of FLUNER 10MG TABLET are an increase in body weight and appetite, a blocked or runny nose, feeling low or depressed, problems with sleeping, nausea, constipation, stomach pain, muscle aches, painful breasts, menstrual problems, and feeling tired. introduction:
Introduction About AMNURITE BETA 10/40 TABLET

AMNURITE BETA 10/40 TABLET is a combination of Amitriptyline and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Tricyclic antidepressants and Beta blockers respectively. It is used to manage migraine with co-morbid conditions like insomnia, neuralgic pain, hypertension, and anxiety.

Migraine is a neurological condition characterized by intense, throbbing head pain and, typically, includes other physical symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light, sound, or smell.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep.

Neuropathic pain is caused by damage or injury to the nerves that transfer information between the brain and spinal cord from the skin, muscles, and other parts of the body.

Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.

Anxiety is an emotion characterized by feelings of tension, worried thoughts, and physical changes like increased blood pressure.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver problems or heart problems or high blood pressure.

Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before taking this medicine. The most common side effects are weight gain, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, drowsiness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Take AMNURITE BETA 10/40 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water, do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS

RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS contains Rizatriptan which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective serotonin 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor agonist. RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is used in adults to manage headache phase of migraine attack.  

RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Rizatriptan. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from moderate/mild/severe high blood pressure (which is not controlled by medication), stroke, peripheral vascular disease (condition marked by blockage of blood vessels), heart problems (such as heart attack, angina), and/or severe kidney/liver problems.

Before taking RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, family history of heart disease, headache (associated with dizziness, difficulty in walking, lack of coordination), short lived symptoms (such as chest pain, tightness), and/or mild to moderate kidney/liver problems.

RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary as it is not known whether the medicine can cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid nursing the child for next 24 hours after taking the medicine since it may cause unwanted effects in the nursing child.

RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS are tingling sensation of hands/feet, headache, sleeplessness, dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS
Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
mechanismOfAction:
How RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS Works

RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS works by constricting the blood vessels that surround the brain which results in reduced swelling in the blood vessels thus providing relief from headache that occurs in migraine attack in affected individuals.

Tablet

Take RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Take RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS as advised by your physician. Place RIZANET 10MG ORAL DISINTEGRATING STRIPS inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About BETAKON M TABLET

BETAKON M TABLET is a combination of Flunarizine and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers and Beta-Blockers respectively. It is used as a prophylactic medication for migraine.

It is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head which can be of moderate to severe pain. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as nausea, weakness, sensitivity to light and sound.

BETAKON M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having depressive illness, parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), urinary tract obstruction, low blood pressure, diabetes mellitus, liver impairment, second-or third-degree heart block, bronchial asthma.

Before taking BETAKON M TABLET inform your doctor if you have signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky and history of allergic reactions.

Along management with BETAKON M TABLET your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes such as taking adequate sleep, doing regular exercise and eating balanced diet. BETAKON M TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women, which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking BETAKON M TABLET are increase in body weight, increased appetite, blocked or runny nose, problems with sleeping, sleepiness, nausea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

A. Drug – Drug interactions:

Before taking BETAKON M TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage anxiety Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, fluvoxamine

Medicine used to control high blood pressure Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, perindopril, hydralazine, clonidine, spironolactone, verapamil, diltiazem, nifedipine, nisoldipine, nicardipine, isradipine and lacidipine

Introduction About MIGARID 10MG TABLET

MIGARID 10MG TABLET contains Flunarizine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel blockers. It is used to manage migraine. A migraine is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain that can be moderate to severe. This generally involves one side of your head. The most common symptoms include nausea, weakness and sensitivity to light and sound.

MIGARID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for patients having depressive illness or a history of recurrent depression and Parkinson’s disease. MIGARID 10MG TABLET should not be taken by pregnant and breastfeeding women and children. MIGARID 10MG TABLET should be used with caution by the elderly. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side-effects of MIGARID 10MG TABLET are an increase in body weight and appetite, a blocked or runny nose, feeling low or depressed, problems with sleeping, nausea, constipation, stomach pain, muscle aches, painful breasts, menstrual problems, and feeling tired. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

MIGARID 10MG TABLET effectively helps in the management of migraine by management of narrowing of blood vessels.

introduction:
Introduction About ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET

ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET is a combination of Flunarizine and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers and Beta-Blockers respectively. It is used as a prophylactic medication for migraine.

It is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head which can be of moderate to severe pain. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as nausea, weakness, sensitivity to light and sound.

ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having depressive illness, parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), urinary tract obstruction, low blood pressure, diabetes mellitus, liver impairment, second-or third-degree heart block, bronchial asthma.

Before taking ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky and history of allergic reactions.

Along management with ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes such as taking adequate sleep, doing regular exercise and eating balanced diet. ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women, which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET are increase in body weight, increased appetite, blocked or runny nose, problems with sleeping, sleepiness, nausea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET
Prevents migraine
mechanismOfAction:
How ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET Works

ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET contains flunarizine and propranolol which helps in managing migraine, where flunarizine works by dilating the blood vessels in the brain and improving blood flow to the brain by managing throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head and propranolol works by managing the dilation of blood vessels and stabilizing serotonin levels and it effectively reduces the intensity and frequency of migraine attack.

Take ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow ZINEPRA 10MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RIZACT 5MG TABLET

RIZACT 5MG TABLET contains Rizatriptan which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective serotonin 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor agonist. RIZACT 5MG TABLET is used in adults to manage headache phase of migraine attack.  

RIZACT 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Rizatriptan. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from moderate/mild/severe high blood pressure (which is not controlled by medication), stroke, peripheral vascular disease (condition marked by blockage of blood vessels), heart problems (such as heart attack, angina), and/or severe kidney/liver problems.

Before taking RIZACT 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, family history of heart disease, headache (associated with dizziness, difficulty in walking, lack of coordination), short lived symptoms (such as chest pain, tightness), and/or mild to moderate kidney/liver problems.

RIZACT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary as it is not known whether the medicine can cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid nursing the child for next 24 hours after taking the medicine since it may cause unwanted effects in the nursing child.

RIZACT 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIZACT 5MG TABLET are tingling sensation of hands/feet, headache, sleeplessness, dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIZACT 5MG TABLET
Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
mechanismOfAction:
How RIZACT 5MG TABLET Works

RIZACT 5MG TABLET works by constricting the blood vessels that surround the brain which results in reduced swelling in the blood vessels thus providing relief from headache that occurs in migraine attack in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use RIZACT 5MG TABLET

Tablet

Take RIZACT 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Oral Disintegrating Tablet / Mouth Dissolving Tablet:

Take RIZACT 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place RIZACT 5MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET

NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET is a combination of Domperidone and Naproxen, which belong to the groups of medicines called antiemetics and NSAIDs (non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), respectively. It is used to manage the symptoms of migraine, menstrual migraine, and chronic daily headaches associated with nausea and vomiting.

A migraine is a recurring headache that often involves one side of the head and causes severe pain that is pulsating or throbbing and is accompanied by nausea, weakness, and sensitivity to sound and light.

NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver, kidney, or heart problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding in the stomach or intestine, intestinal tears, or pituitary gland tumours. NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease, diabetes, high cholesterol, systemic lupus erythematosus, a blood clotting disorder, a history of gastrointestinal diseases, and a habit of drinking or smoking.

NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy, while breastfeeding, or in children less than 5 years old. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 60). The common side effect of taking NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET may include dry mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET

Manage symptoms of

Migraine
Menstrual migraine
Chronic daily headache
mechanismOfAction:
How NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET Works

NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET effectively manages migraine, which is commonly associated with nausea and vomiting, by blocking the centres in the brain and stomach that regulate nausea and vomiting. It also increases the contractions and movements in the stomach. NAPROSYN D 500MG TABLET stops the pain pathways and reduces the release of substances (prostaglandins) that cause inflammation, thus decreasing pain and inflammation.

Introduction About BETACAP PLUS 10MG CAPSULE

BETACAP PLUS 10MG CAPSULE is a combination of Flunarizine and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers and Beta-Blockers respectively. It is used as a prophylactic medication for migraine.

Interactions

A. Drug – Drug interactions:

Before taking BETACAP PLUS 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage anxiety Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, fluvoxamine
Medicines that help in getting sleep such as hypnotics, tranquilizer Ex. diazepam, chlordiazepoxide
Oral contraceptives such as ethinyl estradiol (medicine used to manage pregnancy)
Medicine used to control high blood pressure Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, perindopril, hydralazine, clonidine, spironolactone, verapamil, diltiazem, nifedipine, nisoldipine, nicardipine, isradipine and lacidipine
Insulin (used to manage diabetes)
Ergotamine, dihydroergotamine, sumatriptan or rizatriptan (used to manage migraine)
Amiodarone, adenosine, disopyramide, quinidine, amiodarone, propafenone (used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Digitalis glycosides such as digoxin (used to manage heart failure)
Adrenaline (used to manage anaphylactic shock)
Lidocaine (used to manage irregular heartbeat or as a local anaesthetic to provide numbing effect before minor procedures)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Ibuprofen and indomethacin (used to manage pain and inflammation)
Chlorpromazine and thioridazine (used for psychiatric illness)
Warfarin (used to manage blood clots)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Theophylline (used to manage asthma)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of BETACAP PLUS 10MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of BETACAP PLUS 10MG CAPSULE includes sedation, weakness, difficulty breathing, low blood pressure, drowsiness, fits, dilated pupils, an excessively slowed heartbeat with symptoms such as dizziness, sickness, confusion, hallucinations, body spasms, breathlessness on exertion, fainting or coma.

Introduction About CIPLAR PLUS 10 TABLET

CIPLAR PLUS 10 TABLET is a combination of Flunarizine and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers and Beta-Blockers respectively. It is used as a prophylactic medication for migraine.

It is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head which can be of moderate to severe pain. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as nausea, weakness, sensitivity to light and sound.

CIPLAR PLUS 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having depressive illness, parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), urinary tract obstruction, low blood pressure, diabetes mellitus, liver impairment, second-or third-degree heart block, bronchial asthma.

Before taking CIPLAR PLUS 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky and history of allergic reactions.

Along management with CIPLAR PLUS 10 TABLET your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes such as taking adequate sleep, doing regular exercise and eating balanced diet. CIPLAR PLUS 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women, which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking CIPLAR PLUS 10 TABLET are increase in body weight, increased appetite, blocked or runny nose, problems with sleeping, sleepiness, nausea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Low blood pressure

A strict fasting diet

name: Almotan 6.25mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET contains Almotriptan which belongs to a group of medicines called Selective Serotonin receptor agonists. ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is used for acute management of migraines with or without aura (blind spots) in adults and adolescents (aged 12 – 17 years). Migraine is a type of headache that causes moderate to severe throbbing or pulsing pain on one or both sides of your head which is usually characterized by symptoms such as nausea, visual disturbance, dizziness, numbness, tingling, irritability, difficulty speaking and temporary loss of vision.  

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having allergy to Almotriptan or any of the ingredients of this medicine, stroke (brain attack), diseases that restrict blood supply to the heart (such as heart attack, chest pain while at rest and activity, heart problems without pain, severe and uncontrolled mild or moderate high blood pressure), peripheral vascular disease (a circulation disorder that causes obstruction of the large arteries in the arms or legs) and severe liver disease.

Before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are diabetic, migraine type which has not been diagnosed or have headache symptoms which are different from your usual migraine attacks such as hearing noise in ears, short lived paralysis of one side of the body, paralysis of the muscles that control eye movement.

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women and in women with childbearing potential only if it is clearly advised necessary by your doctor. ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children (less than 12 years of age). The most common side effects of taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET are dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, vomiting, and tiredness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET

It is used for acute management of migraines with or without aura (blind spots) in adults and adolescents (aged 12 – 17 years).
mechanismOfAction:
How ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET Works

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is a selective serotonin receptor agonist which works by binding to certain receptors (5-HT1B and 5-HT1D, which is responsible for basic brain function) in the blood vessels of the brain that cause narrowing of the vessels and reduce blood flow to the brain thus resulting in the blockade of transmission of pain signals to the brain which produce relief from the migraine pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET

Take ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. You should avoid breastfeeding for 24 hours after taking this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness while taking this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.
ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution if you have severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver disease. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to almotriptan or any of the other ingredients of this medicine. It should be used with caution if you are allergic to sulphonamides (such as sulfamethoxazole). Consult your doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with disease that restrict blood flow to the heart such as heart attack, chest pain or discomfort due to stress, heart problems without pain, chest pain at rest, severe high blood pressure, uncontrolled mild or moderate high blood pressure. ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with risk of heart disease that include high cholesterol, obesity, diabetes, smoking, family history of heart disease, and postmenopausal females. Consult your doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is recommended for use in adolescents (aged 12 – 17 years) but not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.
ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET.

Others

ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Had a stroke (brain damage) or experienced a reduction in the blood flow to the brain
Had an obstruction of the large arteries in the arms or legs

Before taking ALMOTAN 6.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:       

Have migraine which has not been diagnosed
Have headache symptoms which are different from your usual migraine attacks Ex. hearing noise in ears, vertigo (sudden spinning of head), short lived paralysis of one side of the body, paralysis of the muscles that control eye movement

introduction:
Introduction About NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET

NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET is a combination of Domperidone and Naproxen, which belong to the groups of medicines called antiemetics and NSAIDs (non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), respectively. It is used to manage the symptoms of migraine, menstrual migraine, and chronic daily headaches associated with nausea and vomiting.

A migraine is a recurring headache that often involves one side of the head and causes severe pain that is pulsating or throbbing and is accompanied by nausea, weakness, and sensitivity to sound and light.

NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver, kidney, or heart problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding in the stomach or intestine, intestinal tears, or pituitary gland tumours. NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease, diabetes, high cholesterol, systemic lupus erythematosus, a blood clotting disorder, a history of gastrointestinal diseases, and a habit of drinking or smoking.

NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy, while breastfeeding, or in children less than 5 years old. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 60). The common side effect of taking NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET may include dry mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET

Manage symptoms of

Migraine
Menstrual migraine
Chronic daily headache
mechanismOfAction:
How NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET Works

NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET effectively manages migraine, which is commonly associated with nausea and vomiting, by blocking the centres in the brain and stomach that regulate nausea and vomiting. It also increases the contractions and movements in the stomach. NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET stops the pain pathways and reduces the release of substances (prostaglandins) that cause inflammation, thus decreasing pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET

Take NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NAPROSYN D 250MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Low blood pressure

Diabetes mellitus
A strict fasting diet

MIGRAFIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice.

MIGRAFIN P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years and above) since it may induce depressive illness or parkinson’s disease (brain disorder). Consult your doctor before taking MIGRAFIN P TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug – Drug interactions:

Before taking MIGRAFIN P TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage anxiety Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, fluvoxamine
Medicines that help in getting sleep such as hypnotics, tranquilizer Ex. diazepam, chlordiazepoxide
Oral contraceptives such as ethinyl estradiol (medicine used to manage pregnancy)
Medicine used to control high blood pressure Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, perindopril, hydralazine, clonidine, spironolactone, verapamil, diltiazem, nifedipine, nisoldipine, nicardipine, isradipine and lacidipine
Insulin (used to manage diabetes)
Ergotamine, dihydroergotamine, sumatriptan or rizatriptan (used to manage migraine)
Amiodarone, adenosine, disopyramide, quinidine, amiodarone, propafenone (used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Digitalis glycosides such as digoxin (used to manage heart failure)
Adrenaline (used to manage anaphylactic shock)
Lidocaine (used to manage irregular heartbeat or as a local anaesthetic to provide numbing effect before minor procedures)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Ibuprofen and indomethacin (used to manage pain and inflammation)
Chlorpromazine and thioridazine (used for psychiatric illness)
Warfarin (used to manage blood clots)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Theophylline (used to manage asthma)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MIGRAFIN P TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of MIGRAFIN P TABLET includes sedation, weakness, difficulty breathing, low blood pressure, drowsiness, fits, dilated pupils, an excessively slowed heartbeat with symptoms such as dizziness, sickness, confusion, hallucinations, body spasms, breathlessness on exertion, fainting or coma.

introduction:
Introduction About INDERAL F 10MG TABLET

INDERAL F 10MG TABLET is a combination of Flunarizine and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers and Beta-Blockers respectively. It is used as a prophylactic medication for migraine.

It is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head which can be of moderate to severe pain. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as nausea, weakness, sensitivity to light and sound.

INDERAL F 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having depressive illness, parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), urinary tract obstruction, low blood pressure, diabetes mellitus, liver impairment, second-or third-degree heart block, bronchial asthma.

Before taking INDERAL F 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky and history of allergic reactions.

Along management with INDERAL F 10MG TABLET your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes such as taking adequate sleep, doing regular exercise and eating balanced diet. INDERAL F 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women, which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking INDERAL F 10MG TABLET are increase in body weight, increased appetite, blocked or runny nose, problems with sleeping, sleepiness, nausea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of INDERAL F 10MG TABLET
Prevents migraine
mechanismOfAction:
How INDERAL F 10MG TABLET Works

INDERAL F 10MG TABLET contains flunarizine and propranolol which helps in managing migraine, where flunarizine works by dilating the blood vessels in the brain and improving blood flow to the brain by managing throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head and propranolol works by managing the dilation of blood vessels and stabilizing serotonin levels and it effectively reduces the intensity and frequency of migraine attack.
usageDetails:
How to use INDERAL F 10MG TABLET

Take INDERAL F 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow INDERAL F 10MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Rizora 5mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About RIZORA 5MG TABLET

RIZORA 5MG TABLET contains Rizatriptan which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective serotonin 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor agonist. RIZORA 5MG TABLET is used in adults to manage headache phase of migraine attack.  

RIZORA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Rizatriptan. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from moderate/mild/severe high blood pressure (which is not controlled by medication), stroke, peripheral vascular disease (condition marked by blockage of blood vessels), heart problems (such as heart attack, angina), and/or severe kidney/liver problems.

Before taking RIZORA 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, family history of heart disease, headache (associated with dizziness, difficulty in walking, lack of coordination), short lived symptoms (such as chest pain, tightness), and/or mild to moderate kidney/liver problems.

RIZORA 5MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary as it is not known whether the medicine can cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid nursing the child for next 24 hours after taking the medicine since it may cause unwanted effects in the nursing child.

RIZORA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIZORA 5MG TABLET are tingling sensation of hands/feet, headache, sleeplessness, dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIZORA 5MG TABLET
Manage headache experienced during migraine attack in adult patients
mechanismOfAction:
How RIZORA 5MG TABLET Works

RIZORA 5MG TABLET works by constricting the blood vessels that surround the brain which results in reduced swelling in the blood vessels thus providing relief from headache that occurs in migraine attack in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use RIZORA 5MG TABLET

Tablet

Take RIZORA 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Oral Disintegrating Tablet / Mouth Dissolving Tablet:

Take RIZORA 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place RIZORA 5MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUNARIN 5MG TABLET

FLUNARIN 5MG TABLET contains Flunarizine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel blockers. It is used to manage migraine. A migraine is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain that can be moderate to severe. This generally involves one side of your head. The most common symptoms include nausea, weakness and sensitivity to light and sound.

FLUNARIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for patients having depressive illness or a history of recurrent depression and Parkinson’s disease. FLUNARIN 5MG TABLET should not be taken by pregnant and breastfeeding women and children. FLUNARIN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution by the elderly. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side-effects of FLUNARIN 5MG TABLET are an increase in body weight and appetite, a blocked or runny nose, feeling low or depressed, problems with sleeping, nausea, constipation, stomach pain, muscle aches, painful breasts, menstrual problems, and feeling tired. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET

RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET contains Rizatriptan which belongs to the group of medicines called Selective serotonin 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor agonist. RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET is used in adults to manage headache phase of migraine attack.  

RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Rizatriptan. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from moderate/mild/severe high blood pressure (which is not controlled by medication), stroke, peripheral vascular disease (condition marked by blockage of blood vessels), heart problems (such as heart attack, angina), and/or severe kidney/liver problems.

Before taking RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, family history of heart disease, headache (associated with dizziness, difficulty in walking, lack of coordination), short lived symptoms (such as chest pain, tightness), and/or mild to moderate kidney/liver problems.

RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary as it is not known whether the medicine can cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Breastfeeding mothers should avoid nursing the child for next 24 hours after taking the medicine since it may cause unwanted effects in the nursing child.

RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET are tingling sensation of hands/feet, headache, sleeplessness, dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

How RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET Works

RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET works by constricting the blood vessels that surround the brain which results in reduced swelling in the blood vessels thus providing relief from headache that occurs in migraine attack in affected individuals.

Take RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET as advised by your physician. Place RIZACT MD 10 PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET

ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET contains Almotriptan which belongs to a group of medicines called Selective Serotonin receptor agonists. ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET is used for acute management of migraines with or without aura (blind spots) in adults and adolescents (aged 12 – 17 years). Migraine is a type of headache that causes moderate to severe throbbing or pulsing pain on one or both sides of your head which is usually characterized by symptoms such as nausea, visual disturbance, dizziness, numbness, tingling, irritability, difficulty speaking and temporary loss of vision.  

ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having allergy to Almotriptan or any of the ingredients of this medicine, stroke (brain attack), diseases that restrict blood supply to the heart (such as heart attack, chest pain while at rest and activity, heart problems without pain, severe and uncontrolled mild or moderate high blood pressure), peripheral vascular disease (a circulation disorder that causes obstruction of the large arteries in the arms or legs) and severe liver disease.

Before taking ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are diabetic, migraine type which has not been diagnosed or have headache symptoms which are different from your usual migraine attacks such as hearing noise in ears, short lived paralysis of one side of the body, paralysis of the muscles that control eye movement.

ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women and in women with childbearing potential only if it is clearly advised necessary by your doctor. ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children (less than 12 years of age). The most common side effects of taking ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET are dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, vomiting, and tiredness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Uses Of ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET

It is used for acute management of migraines with or without aura (blind spots) in adults and adolescents (aged 12 – 17 years).
mechanismOfAction:
How ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET Works

ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET is a selective serotonin receptor agonist which works by binding to certain receptors (5-HT1B and 5-HT1D, which is responsible for basic brain function) in the blood vessels of the brain that cause narrowing of the vessels and reduce blood flow to the brain thus resulting in the blockade of transmission of pain signals to the brain which produce relief from the migraine pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET

Take ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. ALMOTAN 12.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BETABID FORTE TABLET

BETABID FORTE TABLET is a combination of Flunarizine and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers and Beta-Blockers respectively. It is used as a prophylactic medication for migraine.

It is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head which can be of moderate to severe pain. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as nausea, weakness, sensitivity to light and sound.

BETABID FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having depressive illness, parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), urinary tract obstruction, low blood pressure, diabetes mellitus, liver impairment, second-or third-degree heart block, bronchial asthma.

Before taking BETABID FORTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky and history of allergic reactions.

Along management with BETABID FORTE TABLET your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes such as taking adequate sleep, doing regular exercise and eating balanced diet. BETABID FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women, which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking BETABID FORTE TABLET are increase in body weight, increased appetite, blocked or runny nose, problems with sleeping, sleepiness, nausea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Uses Of BETABID FORTE TABLET
Prevents migraine
mechanismOfAction:
How BETABID FORTE TABLET Works

BETABID FORTE TABLET contains flunarizine and propranolol which helps in managing migraine, where flunarizine works by dilating the blood vessels in the brain and improving blood flow to the brain by managing throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head and propranolol works by managing the dilation of blood vessels and stabilizing serotonin levels and it effectively reduces the intensity and frequency of migraine attack.

Take BETABID FORTE TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow BETABID FORTE TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Consult your doctor before taking BETABID FORTE TABLET.

Others

Parkinson’s disease (brain disorder) or a similar disease

Severe peripheral arterial disease such as numbness, tingling or weakness in the legs, burning or aching pain in the feet or toes while resting
Signs of metabolic acidosis (high acid concentration in body fluids) such as confusion, fast heartbeat, heartbeat
Urinary tract obstruction
Signs of acute porphyria (rare enzymatic defect) such as severe abdominal pain, pain in your chest, legs or back, constipation or diarrhoea
Low blood pressure
Signs of severe blood circulation problems such as tingliness of fingers and toes
Diabetes mellitus
A strict fasting diet
Suffer from unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (high blood pressure due to a tumour near the kidney)

Signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky

Suffer from blood circulation problems (which may cause your fingers and toes to tingle or turn pale or blue)
History of allergic reactions

BETABID FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

BETABID FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years and above) since it may induce depressive illness or parkinson’s disease (brain disorder). Consult your doctor before taking BETABID FORTE TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug – Drug interactions:

Before taking BETABID FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage anxiety Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, fluvoxamine
Medicines that help in getting sleep such as hypnotics, tranquilizer Ex. diazepam, chlordiazepoxide
Oral contraceptives such as ethinyl estradiol (medicine used to manage pregnancy)
Medicine used to control high blood pressure Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, perindopril, hydralazine, clonidine, spironolactone, verapamil, diltiazem, nifedipine, nisoldipine, nicardipine, isradipine and lacidipine
Insulin (used to manage diabetes)
Ergotamine, dihydroergotamine, sumatriptan or rizatriptan (used to manage migraine)
Amiodarone, adenosine, disopyramide, quinidine, amiodarone, propafenone (used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Digitalis glycosides such as digoxin (used to manage heart failure)
Adrenaline (used to manage anaphylactic shock)
Lidocaine (used to manage irregular heartbeat or as a local anaesthetic to provide numbing effect before minor procedures)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Ibuprofen and indomethacin (used to manage pain and inflammation)
Chlorpromazine and thioridazine (used for psychiatric illness)
Warfarin (used to manage blood clots)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Theophylline (used to manage asthma)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of BETABID FORTE TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of BETABID FORTE TABLET includes sedation, weakness, difficulty breathing, low blood pressure, drowsiness, fits, dilated pupils, an excessively slowed heartbeat with symptoms such as dizziness, sickness, confusion, hallucinations, body spasms, breathlessness on exertion, fainting or coma.

introduction:
Introduction About METOPAR TABLET

METOPAR TABLET is a combination of Metoclopramide and Paracetamol which belong to the groups of medicines called Antiemetics and Analgesics respectively. It is used to manage pain, nausea and vomiting associated with migraine attacks.

Migraine is a neurological condition that is thought to be caused by the widening of certain blood vessels in the brain, causing an intense, throbbing, recurrent headache on one side of the head, usually around the temple region, but sometimes it can start in the forehead, around the eye or at the back of the head. There are many symptoms that may accompany migraines; nausea (feeling sick) is one of the most common.

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking METOPAR TABLET because it might make you feel dizzy or sleepy. METOPAR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with stomach and/or digestive tract bleeding, intestinal blockage, recent stomach and/or intestine surgery, phaeochromocytoma (a rare tumour of the adrenal gland) or epilepsy.

METOPAR TABLET should only be used in pregnant women if necessary and should be avoided in breastfeeding women. Before using METOPAR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any history of liver or kidney problems, glutathione deficiency, hemolytic anaemia, dehydration, malnutrition for a long period, breast cancer or Parkinson's disease.

METOPAR TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children under the age of one year.METOPAR TABLET should also be used cautiously with elderly patients. The most common side effects of METOPAR TABLET are headache, dizziness, indigestion, drowsiness, tiredness, restlessness and diarrhoea. If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your doctor.
uses: Manage pain, nausea and vomiting associated with migraine attack
usesDetails:
Uses Of METOPAR TABLET
Manage pain, nausea and vomiting associated with migraine attack
mechanismOfAction:
How METOPAR TABLET Works

METOPAR TABLET provides relief from migraine attacks where Metoclopramide blocks the action of a chemical substance produced in the brain that initiates vomiting along with increasing muscle contractions in the stomach and intestine and Paracetamol works by stopping the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain and fever. This collective action is therefore useful in managing nausea,  vomiting and headaches associated with migraine effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use METOPAR TABLET

Always use METOPAR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration of therapy will be decided by your doctor depending on your age, weight and disease condition. Do not take more than the recommended dosage, as it may lead to side effects.

Introduction About MIGIPLEX

MIGIPLEX is a combination of Flunarizine and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel Blockers and Beta-Blockers respectively. It is used as a prophylactic medication for migraine.

It is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head which can be of moderate to severe pain. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as nausea, weakness, sensitivity to light and sound.

MIGIPLEX is not recommended for use in patients having depressive illness, parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), urinary tract obstruction, low blood pressure, diabetes mellitus, liver impairment, second-or third-degree heart block, bronchial asthma.

Before taking MIGIPLEX inform your doctor if you have signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky and history of allergic reactions.

Along management with MIGIPLEX your doctor might ask you to make some lifestyle changes such as taking adequate sleep, doing regular exercise and eating balanced diet. MIGIPLEX is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women, which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking MIGIPLEX are increase in body weight, increased appetite, blocked or runny nose, problems with sleeping, sleepiness, nausea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Prevents migraine

MIGIPLEX contains flunarizine and propranolol which helps in managing migraine, where flunarizine works by dilating the blood vessels in the brain and improving blood flow to the brain by managing throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head and propranolol works by managing the dilation of blood vessels and stabilizing serotonin levels and it effectively reduces the intensity and frequency of migraine attack.

Medicine used to control high blood pressure Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, perindopril, hydralazine, clonidine, spironolactone, verapamil, diltiazem, nifedipine, nisoldipine, nicardipine, isradipine and lacidipine
Insulin (used to manage diabetes)

Amiodarone, adenosine, disopyramide, quinidine, amiodarone, propafenone (used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Digitalis glycosides such as digoxin (used to manage heart failure)
Adrenaline (used to manage anaphylactic shock)
Lidocaine (used to manage irregular heartbeat or as a local anaesthetic to provide numbing effect before minor procedures)
Cimetidine (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Ibuprofen and indomethacin (used to manage pain and inflammation)
Chlorpromazine and thioridazine (used for psychiatric illness)
Warfarin (used to manage blood clots)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)

Introduction About FLUZ 5MG TABLET

FLUZ 5MG TABLET contains Flunarizine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel blockers. It is used to manage migraine. A migraine is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain that can be moderate to severe. This generally involves one side of your head. The most common symptoms include nausea, weakness and sensitivity to light and sound.

FLUZ 5MG TABLET is not recommended for patients having depressive illness or a history of recurrent depression and Parkinson’s disease. FLUZ 5MG TABLET should not be taken by pregnant and breastfeeding women and children. FLUZ 5MG TABLET should be used with caution by the elderly. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side-effects of FLUZ 5MG TABLET are an increase in body weight and appetite, a blocked or runny nose, feeling low or depressed, problems with sleeping, nausea, constipation, stomach pain, muscle aches, painful breasts, menstrual problems, and feeling tired. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

It is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head which can be of moderate to severe pain. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as nausea, weakness, sensitivity to light and sound.

MIGRABETA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having depressive illness, parkinson’s disease (brain disorder), urinary tract obstruction, low blood pressure, diabetes mellitus, liver impairment, second-or third-degree heart block, bronchial asthma.

Before taking MIGRABETA PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have signs of thyrotoxicosis (condition marked by increased production of thyroid hormone) such as experiencing unexplained weight loss, irregular heartbeat, feeling shacky and history of allergic reactions.

mechanismOfAction:
How MIGRABETA PLUS TABLET Works

MIGRABETA PLUS TABLET contains flunarizine and propranolol which helps in managing migraine, where flunarizine works by dilating the blood vessels in the brain and improving blood flow to the brain by managing throbbing or pulsating pain on one side of your head and propranolol works by managing the dilation of blood vessels and stabilizing serotonin levels and it effectively reduces the intensity and frequency of migraine attack.
